offer.text: My faith says there is fire beneath the world. Step through a portal and bear witness for me.

accept.text: Go with courage. Return with truth.

decline.text: Perhaps the abyss is best left unseen.

in_progress.text: Have you crossed into the fire yet?

ready.text: You have walked among the flames and lived. Tell me everything.

complete.text: Your courage humbles me. The temple is in your debt.
